text:
mira_cs: Quick morning check before the enablement call tomorrow 09:00 PT for Polaris private deployment. Main blockers reported: KMS rotation cadence, CloudTrail delivery to customer bucket, IAM role mapping for cross-account svc, and a transient MTU issue on peering.

dan_sre: I can confirm our side has the peering and BGP up. We saw occasional PMTU blackhole on jumbo frames; workaround is to enforce MSS clamping.

leo_network: @shiv_polaris can you ask your infra team to set MSS=1400 on the firewall for the peering session? Also need explicit route: "10.240.0.0/16 -> peer-172.31.20.10" (next-hop).

shiv_polaris: Will do. Also a KMS question: Polaris security requires an external rotation workflow (HSM-based) every 14 days. Does Redwood accept an external-wrapped DEK or must we use AWS KMS rotation?

dan_sre: We support customer-managed KMS CMKs in your account. If you rotate outside KMS, you need to ensure the data key exchange still matches Redwood's decryption flow. Prefer symmetric CMKs with automatic rotation enabled in KMS for zero-effort. External HSM adds integration risk.

mira_cs: To help, here's an example minimal CloudTrail S3 policy we propose to give Redwood write access for delivery (please replace placeholders):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFW_ACC:role/redwood-cloudtrail-delivery"}, "Action": "s3:PutObject", "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::polaris-redwood-logs/*"}
  ]
}
```

shiv_polaris: That looks good. We prefer to use prefix `redwood/` and lifecycle 365d. I'll post the bucket ARN by EOD.

leo_network: For IAM mapping, we recommend creating a role `redwood-service` in Polaris account with a trust policy for Redwood's service principal (role ARN). Avoid granting root account access in KMS policies.

mira_cs: Noted. Also FYI on renewal risk: Polaris has an internal launch milestone two weeks after onboarding. If we miss the enablement slot and their perf tests are delayed, they flagged potential contract reprioritization. Marking this as medium-high renewal risk until tests pass.

ops-bot: Reminder: Enablement meeting scheduled 2026-06-02 09:00 PT. Zoom link in calendar. Required attendees: mira_cs, dan_sre, leo_network, shiv_polaris.

shiv_polaris: One more: Do you provide CloudWatch logs for the inference nodes or just aggregated delivery? Our SIEM expects JSON events with `request_id`, `model`, `latency_ms`.

dan_sre: We can emit structured logs to CloudWatch and include the fields you mentioned. For real-time alerting, we can wire SNS -> SQS to your SIEM. We'll send a sample event during the call.

mira_cs: Action items: shiv -> provide bucket ARN + firewall MSS change confirmation; leo -> MSS example + route snippet; dan -> sample structured log and KMS guidance for external rotation; mira -> update renewal risk and runbook for the session. I'll post follow-up checklist in this thread after lunch. :white_check_mark:

shiv_polaris: Thanks, we should be ready.
